Asha (Docs): quick heads-up: PR #5120 preview failed. the dashboard sample in /console/observability/examples/dashboard.yaml throws a lint and the go SDK snippet doesn't compile.
Pri (Eng-Obs): saw that. schema v2 changed the `latency_buckets` field into `latency.histogram`. docs still show the old path.
Marta (SDK): also the Go snippet used the old helper `NewCostView` signature. i had updated the lib but forgot to update examples. prepping a tiny PR to fix the example and add a short migration note.
Asha (Docs): can you include both a before/after YAML diff? customers love copy-paste.
Marta (SDK): yes. adding this diff in the migration section:
```diff
- latency_buckets:
-  - 0.01
-  - 0.1
-  - 1.0
+ latency:
+   histogram:
+     - 0.01
+     - 0.1
+     - 1.0
```
Devon (Platform): small ask: while updating examples, please change absolute links to relative ones under `/console/observability` so the preview deploy doesn't choke on prod-only domains. saw two links causing blocked network calls.
Kai (QA): after PRs, i'll run the examples smoke harness. sample curl to test the dashboard render: `curl -s -X POST https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/api/render -d '{"example":"dashboard-v2"}'` and check HTTP 200 + no stack traces in JSON.
Marta (SDK): opened PR 5125 with: updated Go/Ruby/Node snippets, dashboard YAML diff, and relative link fixes. also a short note in the migration guide titled "latency_buckets -> latency.histogram". small code change in Go sample:```go
// new constructor signature
client := obs.NewClient(opts.WithNamespace("console"))
d := client.NewView("cost-latency", obs.ViewConfig{LatencyHistogram: []float64{0.01, 0.1, 1.0}})
```
Asha (Docs): thanks. i also found a misplaced copy of the old Ruby snippet in /examples/playground which references `cost_breakdown.v1`. can you remove that orphan? it's picked up by the site indexer.
Pri (Eng-Obs): removing orphan + adding a redirect note in changelog. not a runtime break since SDK shim accepts old key for a transition period.
site-bot: PR 5125 preview: checks running (spellcheck, render, snippet-compile)
Kai (QA): quick smoke after PR merge: `HTTP 200` and preview inspector shows {"latency":{"histogram":[0.01,0.1,1.0]},"cost":{"units":42}} — no compile errors in Go snippet.
Devon (Platform): thumbs up. i'll schedule a tiny follow-up to prune the legacy snippet index in next week's docs housekeeping.
Asha (Docs): merging once CI green. leaving a TODO to add an explicit note about the Go helper signature change in the SDK changelog. thanks everyone :rocket:
